AI Overview
Drift Boss is a popular, free-to-play HTML5 arcade driving game created by MarketJS. 
How to Play
Controls: The car moves forward automatically. Press and hold the left mouse button or the spacebar to drift to the right, and let go to steer back to the left. 
Goal: Stay on the narrow, winding platforms for as long as possible without falling off the edge. 
Scoring: Your score increases the further you drive along the endless track. 
Features and Progression
Coins: Collect coins during your runs, daily rewards, and spin-to-win bonuses.

Vehicles: Use collected coins to unlock new vehicle skins and cars, such as a taxi, police car, ambulance, and fire truck. 
Boosters: Purchase power-ups before or during gameplay, including Double Score, Car Insurance (which lets you recover if you fall), and Coin Rush.
